text: That night. <break time="0.8s" /> The Student went to bed. <break time="0.8s" /> And fell asleep. <break time="0.8s" /> Thinking of his love. <break time="0.8s" /> When the moon shone in the sky. <break time="0.8s" /> The Nightingale flew to the rose tree. <break time="0.8s" /> And pressed her breast. <break time="0.8s" /> Against the thorn. <break time="0.8s" /> All night long she sang. <break time="0.8s" /> And the cold white moon. <break time="0.8s" /> Leaned down and listened. <break time="0.8s" /> She sang first of the love. <break time="0.8s" /> That is born in the heart of a boy and a girl. <break time="0.8s" /> On the top of the tree. <break time="0.8s" /> A lovely rose began to bloom. <break time="0.8s" /> But it was pale. <break time="0.8s" /> Like the mist over the river. <break time="0.8s" /> Press closer, little Nightingale. <break time="0.8s" /> Cried the tree. <break time="0.8s" /> Or the day will come. <break time="0.8s" /> Before the rose is finished. <break time="0.8s" /> So she pressed closer. <break time="0.8s" /> And her song grew louder and louder. <break time="0.8s" /> A soft pink came. <break time="0.8s" /> Into the leaves of the rose. <break time="0.8s" /> But its heart was still white. <break time="0.8s" /> At last the thorn touched her heart. <break time="0.8s" /> And she felt a sharp pain. <break time="0.8s" /> She sang of the love. <break time="0.8s" /> That never dies. <break time="0.8s" /> And the rose became deep red. <break time="0.8s" /> Like the morning sky. <break time="0.8s" /> Then her voice grew weak. <break time="0.8s" /> And her little wings. <break time="0.8s" /> Began to beat. <break time="0.8s" /> Look, the rose is finished. <break time="0.8s" /> Cried the tree. <break time="0.8s" /> But the Nightingale lay dead. <break time="0.8s" /> In the long grass.
